WHO WE ARE

About Netaji Social and Welfare Trust

Netaji Social and Welfare Trust was established with a vision to create a compassionate and empowered society. Inspired by the ideals of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, the Trust aims to work for the welfare and development of communities through meaningful social initiatives.

Our focus includes education, healthcare, environment, social welfare, women empowerment and youth development.

KNOW MORE →
